185: def loaded_library_identity(contract,maps_text=None):
186:  # Actual selected paths, not assumption from pip/conda disk inventory.
187:  allowed={str(Path(x.get('resolved_path',x['path'])).resolve()):x for x in contract['prospective_library_bindings'] if 'path' in x and 'sha256' in x};selected=[]
188:  mapped=set()
189:  for line in (Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text() if maps_text is None else maps_text).splitlines():
190:   fields=line.split(None,5)
191:   if len(fields)==6 and fields[5].startswith('/') and '(deleted)' not in fields[5]:mapped.add(str(Path(fields[5]).resolve()))
192:  for name in sorted(mapped):
193:   base=Path(name).name
194:   role='torch' if base.startswith(('libtorch','libc10')) else 'cuBLAS' if base.startswith('libcublas') else 'cuDNN' if base.startswith('libcudnn') else 'CUDA_runtime' if base.startswith('libcudart') else 'driver' if base.startswith('libcuda.so') else None
195:   if role is None:continue
196:   p=Path(name);row=allowed.get(name)
197:   if role!='driver':require(row is not None,'Unbound actual loaded library:'+name)
198:   actual=dict(path=name,bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(p),role=role)
199:   if row is not None:require(actual['bytes']==row['bytes'] and actual['sha256']==row['sha256'],'Loaded library bytes/SHA changed:'+name)
200:   selected.append(actual)
201:  require(any(x['role']=='cuBLAS' for x in selected) and any(x['role']=='torch' for x in selected),'Actual cuBLAS/torch map unavailable')
202:  return selected
